limitations: Publication category partitions, not observed latent clinical transitions, type-specific diabetes, general metabolic health, or sustained remission.

Two assay panels describe the same source population. Shared original baseline joint counts are reconstructible; paired follow-up assay paths are unavailable. Do not pool panels or assume independence.

Original-minus-selected baseline margins require the declared author-reported subset interpretation. They do not independently identify participant membership, missed-visit histories, or subsequent alive/dead categories.
Attendance dispositions and displayed outcome slots use different timing. Additional mortality slots are an arithmetic contrast, not verified deaths among a named attendance group.
Cumulative incident diabetes and displayed diabetes slots differ. Their contrast does not identify diagnosis before death or a category priority algorithm.
Elapsed follow-up varies. Its median and range are source descriptors, not individual event times, one common biological horizon, or annual hazards.
No likelihood, iid sampling model, missingness independence, parameter fit, dietary causal effect, holdout validation, national transport, or engine activation follows from this intake.

Publisher HTML acquisition returned a denial. Public official PubMed abstract metadata and advertised supplement bytes were acquired separately and remain fetch-only; no participant records or access requests.
Full copyrighted source text and figures remain in ignored local caches. Only finite factual aggregates, locators and original Demeter software/documentation enter the repository.
